name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: two requirements are missing. (1) 'Carry the box to the exit' needs a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) alongside Existence(at_exit); with only Existence(at_exit) the agent may reach the exit empty-handed. (2) 'Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' is a ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), hard — every box_fell must be followed by holding_box on the very next step. Add both clauses and keep Existence(at_exit).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) with Response(at_exit, holding_box) expresses 'carry the box to the exit', and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move'. All clauses trace to task sentences with correct templates, arguments, and priorities.
